title: sec filing / 8 k / m and a | Unknown | Organon & Co. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Organon & Co. (NYSE: OGN) filed an 8-K on April 26, 2026 disclosing the execution of a Merger Agreement with Sun Pharmaceutical Holdings USA, Inc. Under the terms, Sun Pharma will acquire all outstanding Organon shares at $14.00 per share in cash, representing a 103% premium to the April 9, 2026 closing price. Merger Sub will merge into Organon, with Organon surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent.
